messages:
anya: Noticed a subtle but breaking mismatch in the /v1/metrics/usage docs. The OpenAPI example shows:
```json
{"usage": {"tokens": 123, "requests": 5}}
```
but the runtime actually returns flat fields: `{"usage_tokens": 123, "usage_requests": 5}`. Our internal billing consumer failed when demoing the sample.
oliver: Ugh. Do you have the raw response from staging?
anya: Pasted from staging below:
```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"usage_tokens":123,"usage_requests":5}
```
carla: That explains the client parsing error. The docs generator must still be using the old schema. Will open a docs PR to update the OpenAPI examples and the SDK snippets. Also add a short migration note under API changes.
oliver: Please also check the Go and Rust snippets in the billing quickstart; they access `resp.usage.tokens` and will panic.
carla: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4772 
- replace nested `usage` object example with flat fields in OpenAPI example
- update Python/JS/Go snippets to use `usage_tokens` / `usage_requests` keys
- add Breaking Changes note: mapping examples for integrators (old -> new)
ci-bot: PR created by carla: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4772 
anya: For the Python snippet please use a robust access pattern so demos don't crash: `tokens = resp.get('usage_tokens', 0)` and add a comment explaining the change.
carla: Added the Python adjustment and a tiny JS example: `const tokens = resp.usage_tokens || 0`. Also updated the billing quickstart files as a follow-up commit.
oliver: I ran a grep across the repo for `usage.tokens` and `resp.usage` and pushed a small follow-up PR for the quickstart (links in the PR discussion).
ci-bot: docs-linter passed for PR #4772 — https://ci.redwood.ai/13011
carla: Merged. Preview site updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/metrics/usage now shows the flat response and migration note.
anya: Will run a quick smoke against the JS/Go billing demos on staging to ensure no more panics.
anya: Smoke test: JS demo fine, Go demo fixed after small nil-check added in client wrapper. Closing loop.
